authorization_original: 现在我们敲定泥岩电性吧，调研一下

mudstone.geological_role: Mudstone lithology in the profile; strong/medium weathering are not assigned different electrical properties without evidence
mudstone.anisotropy_model: isotropic research simplification, not evidence of isotropic mudstone

provenance.epsilon_center_and_span: Explicit design choices for a moderately dispersive comparison, not values fitted to the literature or Line9 radar
provenance.tau: 8ns is a simplified research timescale within the 7.6-20.8ns secondary-relaxation times in Wagner2013 clay rock; source is fractional GDR, not single Debye
provenance.sigma_DC: 3mS/m is a research choice within 0.49-8.83mS/m intact ordinary mudstone results in Romhild2019 Table2; NaCl-saturated analogues, not a site calibration

mudstone_sigma1mS.purpose: Change DC loss only; not a certified dry state

mudstone_sigma9mS.purpose: Change DC loss only; not a certified wet state or full uncertainty bound

mudstone_nondispersive.purpose: Matched centre real permittivity but different polarization loss; constitutive diagnostic, not physical clean truth

limitations: No retrieved complex spectrum directly characterizes the site mudstone; no field-data fitting was performed
Centre12/span3 are not measured mudstone bounds; the centre ordering cover/mudstone/sandstone is an assumption
The conductivity variants do not cover uncertain permittivity, dispersion shape, fractures, weathering or bedding anisotropy
The existing low-loss cover recipe is still uncalibrated; assigning this mudstone does not certify the complete geological model
Positive single-Debye parameters support passive continuum dispersion, not FDTD convergence or radar detectability
Do not add effective MHz conductivity inferred from total epsilon loss on top of this Debye polarization loss
Existing H5 geometry/material packages remain historical; no material file is overwritten by this design
